claim: India had the highest number of studies (23) in the global pooled analysis across 81 countries, indicating intensive research attention on vitamin D deficiency in India.
stance_target: India's vitamin D deficiency problem is scientifically well-documented and widely recognized
quoted_support: The number of studies varied from one in Uganda to 23 in India.

claim: Globally 47.9% (95% CI 44.9-50.9%) of people have serum 25(OH)D below 50 nmol/L, the standard Endocrine Society threshold for vitamin D deficiency, from 2000-2022.
stance_target: Global vitamin D deficiency at Endocrine Society threshold affects nearly half the world population
